tools.name: list_memos
tools.title: List Memos
tools.description: List the user's Wisply recordings (memos), newest first. Read-only. Returns id, title, timestamps, duration, and a short summary when insights exist.

offset.description: Number of memos to skip for paging. Default 0.

tools.name: search_transcripts
tools.title: Search Transcripts
tools.description: Search recording titles, summaries, and transcripts for a phrase. Read-only. Returns matching memos with a short excerpt around the first hit. Scans only the newest 500 memos.

tools.name: get_live_transcript
tools.title: Get Live Transcript
tools.description: Return the transcript of the recording currently in progress, plus its state and duration. Read-only. Empty when nothing is recording; never starts a recording.

tools.name: get_action_items
tools.title: Get Action Items
tools.description: Return the AI-generated action items and open questions for a memo (default: the newest memo that has insights), plus the follow-up proposals currently waiting for the user in Wisply. Read-only: never creates, confirms or runs anything.

memo_id.description: Memo id from list_memos. Defaults to the newest memo with insights.
